KNIGHT (subs.):
I A champion: मटः।
II A
title: *अनुबेरणः, भटः,

KNIGNT (v.): *अनुबेरणं
or
भटं करोति, भटोपाधिं
 ददाति (दा, c. 3.).

KNIGHTHOOD:
I The dignity: *अनुबेरणत्वम्;
 मटपदम्।
II The knights collectively^1: expr.
by pl.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20210319. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/53.

KNIGHTLY: expr. by gen. or comp.: v.
Heroic.

KNIT (v.):
I To fasten: q.v.: बध्नाति (बन्ध्,
c. 9.).
II With needles: सं-सीव्यति (सिव्,
c. 4.).
III To connect: q.v.: संयोजयति
(c. of युज्). Ph.:
to k. the brows:
भ्रूकुटीं बध्नाति।
